name: Agent
author: Omarchy
description: Ask Omarchy's default agent to work with this folder or selection, with Synchro catalog access.

action.exec: omarchy agent prompt "Work with the current Synchro file-browser context. Run the executable named by SYNCHRO_BIN with arguments 'agent context --compact' first; it reads the complete selection and working folder from the inherited environment and documents the read-only catalog and result-navigation commands. Use that CLI contract for indexed discovery and deterministic metadata. Synchro MCP is optional and is never required for this task."
